starting-off-message-from-the-king.speaker: King's Messenger
starting-off-message-from-the-king.text: I take it you are [player name]? King Lathas sent this message for you. He's not a man you'd want to keep waiting.
The messenger gives you a scroll.

starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas.player: I received your message my liege. How may I serve the kingdom?

starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off-talking-to-king-lathas.text: Ahh... adventurer. The repair work on the Well of Voyage has been completed. We're finally ready to move against my brother.

options.text: I assume you have a plan?

steps.player: I assume you have a plan?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.

steps.player: Elves? I've never seen an elf before.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Well that may well change soon. Apparently, my brother has been causing them quite a bit of trouble. As such, they've agreed to help us get rid of him once and for all.

steps.player: So what do I need to do?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. Lord Iorwerth, the leader of the elves, will send some representatives to meet you on the other side.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.

steps.player: Very well. Anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: My brother may not be the only threat you face. I hear the elves are currently dealing with a rebellion. The rebels likely won't take kindly to you working with their enemy so be on the look out.

steps.player: I see. I'll be careful.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Good luck adventurer.

steps.player: Actually, I don't think I'm ready for this yet.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: As you wish. Return to me when you are ready and we will begin.

options.text: What's the deal with your brother again?

steps.player: What's the deal with your brother again?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: My brother, King Tyras, was always a bit of an explorer. He went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: As a result, I had a wall built around West Ardougne to act as a barrier between him and the rest of the world. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I knew people would never believe the truth, so I had the plague made up as an excuse for the cordon. I'm not proud of it, but it was the only way to keep people safe.

steps.player: But now we're ready to stop him.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Indeed we are. My brother has been gathering strength in the west, preparing to move against us. But now that we have a way through, we can move against him first.

options.text: Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?

steps.player: Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.

steps.player: Sounds good. See you later.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Farewell adventurer. Return to me once you are ready to begin.

starting-off-talking-to-lathas-again.player: My liege. What must I do again?

starting-off-talking-to-lathas-again.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off-talking-to-lathas-again.text: You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. Lord Iorwerth, the leader of the elves, will send some representatives to meet you on the other side.

starting-off-talking-to-lathas-again.speaker: King Lathas
starting-off-talking-to-lathas-again.text: With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.

entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.speaker: Idris
entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.text: Halt human! What are you doing here?

entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.speaker: Idris
entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.text: Wait! What was that? What the...
Morvran and Essyllt appear and kill Idris, then head towards the player.

entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.speaker: Morvran
entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.text: Are you the human by the name of [player name]?

entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.speaker: Essyllt
entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.text: Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.

entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.speaker: Essyllt
entering-isafdar-encountering-idris-morv.text: You should speak with Lord Iorwerth. He will help you track down that brigand Tyras. You'll find his camp in the north west of the forest.

entering-isafdar-talking-to-the-elf-trac.speaker: Elf Tracker
entering-isafdar-talking-to-the-elf-trac.text: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.

entering-isafdar-talking-to-the-elf-trac.speaker: Elf Tracker
entering-isafdar-talking-to-the-elf-trac.text: Leave me be. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.player: Hello there, I'm [player name]. Your scouts said that I should come and see you.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.text: Ahh... [player name]. Welcome to Tirannwn. I understand you've been sent here to rid us of that criminal Tyras. I offer my full support.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.text: Unfortunately, most of my troops are currently dealing with a group of renegade elves. That does mean we're a bit more limited than we otherwise would be.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.player: I see. I'll need to play this smart then.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.text: Indeed. Now, Tyras and his forces moved camp recently so your first step will be to find their new camp. I have a tracker currently working in that area. I suggest you join up with him.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.text: You'll find him at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.

entering-isafdar-speaking-with-lord-iorw.player: Thank you. I shall return when my task is complete.

entering-isafdar-talking-to-iorwerth-aga.player: Where can I find that tracker again?

entering-isafdar-talking-to-iorwerth-aga.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
entering-isafdar-talking-to-iorwerth-aga.text: He should be at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.text: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.player: No I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.text: And you have something to prove this?

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.text: As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: Good day [player name]. How may I help you now?

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.player: Your scout refused to help. He asked for proof that you sent me.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: Bless his loyalty but curse his suspicion. Here he will recognise this.
If the player doesn't have enough inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a crystal pendant but you don't have enough room for it.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: If the player has enough inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth gives you a crystal pendant.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.player: No I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: And you have something to prove this?
You show the tracker the crystal pendant.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: That's Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.player: I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethren instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: [player name], how goes your search? Any luck hunting down that brigand?

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.player: I've found no trace of him as yet.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: I'm sure you will find something at his old camp that can help you.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.player: I'll take a look and see what I can find.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-lord-i.text: Good. Come find me when you've located the camp.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.player: What should I be doing again?

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.text: Check out the west end of the camp and see if you can find anything. I'll keep looking here. Let me know if you find anything.

tracking-tyras-camp-finding-the-tracks.text: You try to follow the footprints but they lead into impassable woodland.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.player: I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.text: These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?

tracking-tyras-camp-speaking-with-the-el.player: Thanks... I'll see what I can find.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.player: I found it a short distance west of here.

tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.speaker: Elf Tracker
tracking-tyras-camp-returning-to-the-elf.text: I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.

tracking-tyras-camp-fighting-the-tyras-g.speaker: Tyras Guard
tracking-tyras-camp-fighting-the-tyras-g.text: I see you making friends with that elf, traitor!

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.speaker: General Hining
tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.text: Yes, is there anything I can help with? I'm General of what's left of this army and I'm rather busy.

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.player: If you're a General can you help me meet the king?

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.speaker: General Hining
tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.text: The king will see no one. He can trust no one!

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.player: Is there no way I can see him?

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.speaker: General Hining
tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.text: In the coming battle he will stand between us and the end. Then you will see him.

tracking-tyras-camp-talking-to-general-h.player: Not quite what I had in mind.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: [player name] how goes your search... Any luck hunting down that brigand?

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.player: I've finally tracked the brute down. His camp is in a secluded bit of forest, almost directly south of here.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: Good job. As we don't have the troops available to take on his forces directly, I suggest we try some alternative tactics.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: I have this book here which details an explosive reaction. We should be able to use it to create a bomb.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.player: Well that should make short work of Tyras.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: Indeed. Have a read through and see what you think. Once you have, let me know if you have any questions.
If the player doesn't have any inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth gives you a book.

making-a-bomb-losing-the-book.player: I lost my copy of The Big Book of Bangs.

making-a-bomb-losing-the-book.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-losing-the-book.text: Its lucky I had a scribe make a few copies then, is it not?
If the player doesn't have any inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.

making-a-bomb-losing-the-book.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth gives you a book.

steps.player: Thank you.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
making-a-bomb-speaking-with-lord-iorwert.text: Good day [player name]. Have you had any luck with that book?

steps.player: I need some quicklime.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Quicklime?

steps.player: Apparently it's made by heating limestone.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Ah, I see. There's a mine directly east of here where you can mine limestone.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

steps.player: I need some sulphur.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Check the shore south of the old camp you were at earlier. I've seen sulphur there in the past, it comes from that poisoned lake.

steps.player: Sounds good, thanks.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

steps.player: I need some naphtha.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Naphtha?

steps.player: According to the book, you get it through the fractional distillation of coal tar.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Well you should be able to get some coal tar from that poisoned lake to the south. As for the rest, I'm afraid I don't have the chemistry knowledge to understand it.

steps.player: Hmm... I know someone from Ardougne who might be able to help. She knows a thing or two about chemistry.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Perfect! Take the book to her and see if she can help. Just don't tell her what it's for. Even if she's trustworthy, we can't take any risks.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Anyway, is there anything else I can help with?

steps.player: I need a barrel.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Have a look around the camp, there should be some empty barrels lying around.

steps.player: Will do, thanks.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

steps.player: I need a fuse.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Some sort of fabric should work. You can use the loom here if needed.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Is there anything else I can help with?

steps.player: That's all thanks.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: Let me know if you need anything else.

making-a-bomb-speaking-with-the-chemist.prompt: What do you want to talk about?

steps.player: Good day. I was hoping you could help me with something. I have a book which mentions the fractional distillation of coal tar. I don't know how to do that though.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: Ah, you'll be wanting to use the still then. It's just outside.

steps.player: How do I use it?

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: It's quite simple really. You have to get the still heat up very high for it to work. However, if it gets too hot it will burn out and you will have to start over.

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: You must also watch the pressure, if it gets too high you will also have to start over. There are valves to control pressure and tar flow. These will also affect the heat of the still.

steps.player: Is that all?

steps.speaker: Chemist
steps.text: You'll also need plenty of coal to keep the still hot.

steps.player: I see, thanks for the information.

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.text: Good day [player.] Have you had any luck with that book?

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.text: Excellent work. Now we can finally deal with Tyras.

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.player: So what should I do? Plant it in his camp?

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.text: No, you'll be spotted by the guards if you try that. You'll need to get it in from outside.

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.text: Tyras and his men have used catapults against us in the past. Maybe you can turn one of them against him.

committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-returning-to-lord-io.text: Now you'd better get going. Don't forget, you'll need a tinderbox to light that fuse. Return to me once the deed is done.

committing-regicide-bribing-the-guard.player: I was wondering what you were doing out here?

committing-regicide-bribing-the-guard.speaker: Tyras guard
committing-regicide-bribing-the-guard.text: I was just wondering what I was doing here too. I'm meant to be looking after this catapult but I can't keep my mind on the job. We've been living off field rations for almost a year now.

committing-regicide-bribing-the-guard.speaker: Tyras guard
committing-regicide-bribing-the-guard.text: I keep seeing rabbits in this forest. What I wouldn't give to eat one, but I'm not quick enough to kill any and I'm no good with a bow.

steps.player: I can see how that would be distracting.
Well I have one here for you.

steps.speaker: Tyras guard
steps.text: You cooked me a rabbit! Thanks a lot. You don't mind watching things while I take five to eat it, do you?

committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.speaker: Tyras guard
committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.text: They say the king died from a flying fire ball. Are you certain no one messed with the catapult while I was eating?

committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.player: I was the only one here. I was watching the whole time.

committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.speaker: Tyras guard
committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.text: These are dark times, I must prepare for the coming darkness.

committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.speaker: General Hining
committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.text: This is not a good place to be, go and prepare for the coming darkness.

committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.speaker: General Hining
committing-regicide-talking-to-tyras-for.text: There is no great hero left to fight back the forces that face us now... Go, leave, prepare for the darkness. While you still have time!

committing-regicide-talking-to-the-elf-t.speaker: Elf Tracker
committing-regicide-talking-to-the-elf-t.text: I take it that the huge explosion I just heard was you?

committing-regicide-talking-to-the-elf-t.player: Yes, I've finally dealt with Tyras, he should cause you no more problems.

committing-regicide-talking-to-the-elf-t.speaker: Elf Tracker
committing-regicide-talking-to-the-elf-t.text: This is good news indeed. Lord Iorwerth will be very happy. You should go and let him know.

committing-regicide-reporting-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-reporting-to-lord-io.text: Good good... One of my scouts reported that they saw his tent in a ball of flames. You have done well.

committing-regicide-reporting-to-lord-io.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-reporting-to-lord-io.text: I'm sure you will want to get back to your king and tell him. He will undoubtedly want some proof. He should trust me enough in this matter, Give him this letter, it verifies that the job is done.
If the player doesn't have any inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a scroll but you don't have enough room for it.

committing-regicide-reporting-to-lord-io.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth gives you a scroll.

steps.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
steps.text: As a token of my own thanks, I give you access to the pass through Arandar. You'll find the start of the trail in the far north east of the woods.

steps.player: Thank you my lord.

committing-regicide-losing-the-scroll.player: Lord Iorwerth, I have lost the message for King Lathas.

committing-regicide-losing-the-scroll.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-losing-the-scroll.text: Here have another copy, but don't let it fall into the wrong hands.
If the player doesn't have any inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth tries to give you a scroll but you don't have enough room for it.

committing-regicide-losing-the-scroll.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Lord Iorwerth gives you a scroll.

steps.player: Thank you my lord.

committing-regicide-talking-to-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-talking-to-lord-iorw.text: Have you delivered the message to King Lathas yet?

committing-regicide-talking-to-lord-iorw.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
committing-regicide-talking-to-lord-iorw.text: There is no time for delay, he'll need to see it.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: Are you the human by the name [player name]?

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: Thank Seren, maybe all is not yet lost.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: I am Arianwyn, leader of the Elven Resistance. We've been watching you since you arrived in Tirannwn. We know it was you that murdered King Tyras.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: There is much to explain and little time. You carry a message from Lord Iorwerth, do you not?

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.player: Well you seem to know everything else so I'll not lie. Yes.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: Good, we understand each other well. Now hand it here and find the truth of who your real employer is.
You show the message to the elf, he moves his lips silently and the seal on the message is parted.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.player: I had no idea! Why would the king do this?

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: I have a few ideas, now is not the time to discuss them though. For now, you should go to King Lathas as normal. Give him the message and act like nothing unusual has happened.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: Once you are done, return to Tirannwn and seek out Islwyn and Eluned. You'll find them roaming the Isafdar forest. They will bring you to me.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.player: You want me to help you? Okay, what's in it for me?

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: The chance for redemption after all you've done? If that doesn't take your fancy, consider this...

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: This isn't a struggle for land or title. It is a war for life, all life. If Iorwerth and Lathas manage to summon Zamorak, we all die.

reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.speaker: Arianwyn
reporting-to-king-lathas-meeting-arianwy.text: Deliver your message, act normal. We'll meet again soon.

reporting-to-king-lathas-speaking-with-k.speaker: King Lathas
reporting-to-king-lathas-speaking-with-k.text: This is grand news indeed! You'll forgive me if I'm a little apprehensive about this, but I take it you do have proof?
If the player doesn't have the scroll with them:

steps.player: No, I have nothing to corroborate this.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: I am sure you have done as you say, but on this matter I can afford no doubts. You must find something to confirm your story.

steps.player: I'll see what I can do.

reporting-to-king-lathas-speaking-with-k.text: If the player has the scroll with them:

steps.player: Yes, I have a letter sent by Lord Iorwerth.

steps.text: You hand the king the message. He looks at the seal then opens it.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Yes... Good... This will do nicely. Well done, you've done an excellent job.

steps.player: Does this mean we can reveal the truth about the plague?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Not yet I'm afraid. Even with my brother gone, the Dark Lord remains a threat. For now, the plague must remain.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Anyway, I'll send word when I next require your services. Oh, and I guess you'll be wanting your reward.
